simple.meaning: גֹּשֶׁם (gôshem) is a Hebrew action word meaning “rained upon.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Ezekiel, beginning at Ezekiel 22:24. The surrounding contexts include family line, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גֹּשֶׁם (H1656) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: גֹּשֶׁם (gôshem) / H1656 is traced through Ezekiel 22:24 with source-language evidence and verse context.
